title: Careers Archon
theme: Career concepts, megatrends, labour market information, transferable skills, resilience, and initiative

overview.tagline: Win contested board squares by writing stronger Careers curriculum responses.
overview.playerFantasy: Command a future-ready occupation team against a mirrored occupation team in a battle for career territory.
overview.teacherValue: Turns short-answer Careers curriculum questions into repeated written evidence. Each contested square compares the student response with an opponent response and records a score.

gameplayIdentity.playStyle: Archon-inspired tactical board with written response battles
repeatableWorkflow: Choose a gameplay consequence tile after a win

learningObjectives: Describe megatrends in the context of career planning.
Explain how labour market information supports career decisions.
Use transferable skills, resilience, and initiative language accurately.
Write short Careers responses that define a concept, explain its importance, and connect it to a career pathway or workplace example.

sharedStatEffects.description: Winning written clashes can bank small salary gains as the student proves stronger career-planning knowledge.
A portion of writing clash rewards contributes to the class economy.
Stronger written career reasoning supports long-term career success.

employabilityFocus.whyItFits: Students must write clear, accurate short responses using Careers curriculum language.
Students connect concepts such as megatrends and labour market evidence to future pathway decisions.
The board state asks students to adapt after wins, losses, and contested career-planning prompts.

activities.title: Career Board Control
activities.purpose: Move pieces across the board and force written curriculum clashes.

activities.title: Written Clash
activities.purpose: Compare student writing with an opponent response and resolve the contested square.

assessmentEvidence.prompt: Write a Careers curriculum response that defines the concept, explains why it matters, and connects it to career planning or workplaces.

teacherSignals: teacher review queue entry for longer responses
